evidence: Calls attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x4f, converts the integer result to float, and multiplies by the float constant 0.1 (bits 0x3dcccccd). A direct caller invokes it while filling a vector result after another status lookup. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:20222-20238; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:19959-19963.

Clears the observed global slots near 0x7002b43c1a, calls f_7000416d00 and load_rtts_perks_catalog, then calls zero_fill_import_thunk on the global region at 0x7002280ef8 for 0x84c bytes. Its caller is initialize_rtts_data_subsystems. decompiled/main/main_0031.c:52090-52113; caller decompiled/main/main_0031.c:46029-46033.

Calls the record-availability helper with a local output slot. If the helper reports availability, it queries attribute-context selector 0x43 and returns that value; otherwise it returns constant 3. Callers use the returned value in a status calculation. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:35367-35387; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:38557-38561.

Loads a pointer from input+0. When nonnull it tail-calls attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default with that pointer; when null it first calls f_70018450e8 and then tail-calls the same getter. The caller passes a wrapper and consumes the returned pointer. decompiled/main/main_0034.c:15935-15947; caller decompiled/main/main_0034.c:15235-15239.

Queries attribute-context selector 0x52. If the fetched low byte is below 3, returns the fetched value plus 7; otherwise returns it unchanged. A direct caller uses the result in a subsequent calculation. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:20206-20220; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:19983-19986.
